Chicken dinner.title: chicken tomato
steps: preheat oven to 400f.
in a large bowl, combine the chicken, garlic, and onion.
add the tomato and the remaining ingredients and mix well.
bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is browned and the tomato is tender.
let cool and serve.
Chicken dinner.raw_text:
Title: chicken tomato
Steps:
1. preheat oven to 400f.
2. in a large bowl, combine the chicken, garlic, and onion.
3. add the tomato and the remaining ingredients and mix well.
4. bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is browned and the tomato is tender.
5. let cool and serve.

Vegetable pasta.title: tomato basil pasta
steps: heat a large pan of water and bring to a boil.
add the pasta and cook for 3-4 minutes or until al dente.
drain the pasta and add the tomato, garlic and basil.
toss until the tomatoes and herbs are well coated.
serve with a small portion of olive oil and lemon juice over the pasta.
sprinkle with salt and pepper if you like.

Cheese omelet.title: spinach and cheese casserole
steps: preheat oven to 350 degrees f.
in a large bowl, mix together eggs, cheese, and onion.
add spinach and stir until well blended.
spoon into 9x13-inch baking dish.
bake 35 minutes or until golden brown.
let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

Roasted vegetables.title: carrot potato salad
steps: peel and slice potatoes and carrots into small cubes.
add to a large mixing bowl and stir well.
add olive oil and rosemary, stir until well mixed.
cover and chill for 30 minutes.
serve with crusty bread and lemon dressing.
Roasted vegetables.raw_text:
Title: carrot potato salad
Steps:
1. peel and slice potatoes and carrots into small cubes.
2. add to a large mixing bowl and stir well.
3. add olive oil and rosemary, stir until well mixed.
4. cover and chill for 30 minutes.
5. serve with crusty bread and lemon dressing.
